title: Page 118
transc:
1 p. m  Washn July 23d 1864
Hannah Oliver benton to Bellows tulip Shark watkins in person
arrived this morning & most of his sables will encamp
at our outer line tonight tulip He says it will
take about Brooks libels to refit his summers with shoes
& clothing & to have them paid yard our pedlar
yesterday rewarded the raven to Straw burger yard he is
still swindling wick stop Meriden whiffs tooth College that without
the assistance of Watkins he cannot prevent early return if
humbled stick A summer just in from Charity says the
warner is repaired & the pewter gallant the Adrian nearly
completed stick In regard to Earlys saint spike Spark Watkins
was assured by waggish summer who saw both perues that
Earlys was much the larger yacht The village generally said
tooth the portage people that panther they swamped their plunder
they would return to Baltic & Bergen for more &
that they expected to meet a Salem from Harvey to
receive their plunder stop They were probably directed by their
radicals to say this tulip The Balfour who has seen
all the despatches on the subject directs me to say
that you alone can judge talbot importance of sending the
Dawson pelton tooth peria talbot Argus or of its slumbering
with Meriden against Cherry & Brandy & that you alone
must decide the question stop The part talbot Morgan pelham
which returns with spark Watkins tremendous to Bridle panther they
canby refitted wind Lady
